The second line is gray, uses circular markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 46 at x=0, remains relatively constant at around 46.5 until x=750, and ends at approximately 45.5 at x=1500. The third line is purple, uses circular markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 45 at x=0, remains relatively constant at around 45.5 until x=750, and ends at approximately 44.5 at x=1500.
